addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

1	# openPangu-2.0-Op
2	
3	昇腾亲和高性能自定义算子仓库，面向大模型训练与推理场景，提供基于 AscendC、PyPTO、Triton 多种实现方式的高性能算子，并通过Pytorch Adapter(PTA)暴露为`torch.ops.custom.npu_*`接口，支持在Pytorch中直接调用
4	
5	## 项目结构
6

#!/bin/bash
# Copyright (c) 2025 Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.

# INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO NON-INFRINGEMENT, MERCHANTABILITY, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
# See LICENSE in the root of the software repository for the full text of the License.

set -e

########################################################################################################################
# 预定义变量
########################################################################################################################

CURRENT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f ${BASH_SOURCE[0]}))
BUILD_DIR=${CURRENT_DIR}/build
OUTPUT_DIR=${CURRENT_DIR}/output
USER_ID=$(id -u)
PARENT_JOB="false"
HOST_TILING="false"
CHECK_COMPATIBLE="false"
ASAN="false"
UBSAN="false"
COV="false"
CLANG="false"
VERBOSE="false"

PR_CHANGED_FILES=""  # PR场景, 修改文件清单, 可用于标识是否PR场景

if [ "${USER_ID}" != "0" ]; then
    DEFAULT_TOOLKIT_INSTALL_DIR="${HOME}/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest"
    DEFAULT_INSTALL_DIR="${HOME}/Ascend/latest"
else
    DEFAULT_TOOLKIT_INSTALL_DIR="/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest"
    DEFAULT_INSTALL_DIR="/usr/local/Ascend/latest"
fi

CUSTOM_OPTION="-DBUILD_OPEN_PROJECT=ON"
CUSTOM_OPTION+=" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=\"-w\" -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=\"-w\""

########################################################################################################################
# 预定义函数
########################################################################################################################

function help_info() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [options]"
    echo "Options:"
    echo
    echo "-h|--help            Displays help message."
    echo
    echo "-n|--op-name         Specifies the compiled operator. If there are multiple values, separate them with semicolons and use quotation marks. The default is all."
    echo "                     For example: -n \"lightning_indexer\" or -n \"lightning_indexer;sparse_flash_attention\""
    echo
    echo "-c|--compute-unit    Specifies the chip type. If there are multiple values, separate them with semicolons and use quotation marks. The default is ascend910_93."
    echo "                     For example: -c \"ascend910_93\" or -c \"ascend910b\""
    echo
    echo "--tiling_key         Sets the tiling key list for operators. If there are multiple values, separate them with semicolons and use quotation marks. The default is all."
    echo "                     For example: --tiling_key \"1\" or --tiling_key \"1;2;3;4\""
    echo
    echo "--verbose            Displays more compilation information."
    echo
    echo "-u|--test            Unit Test."
    echo
}

function log() {
    local current_time=`date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"`
    echo "[$current_time] "$1
}

function set_env()
{
    source $ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH/bin/setenv.bash || echo "0"

    export BISHENG_REAL_PATH=$(which bisheng || true)

    if [ -z "${BISHENG_REAL_PATH}" ];then
        log "Error: bisheng compilation tool not found, Please check whether the cann package or environment variables are set."
        exit 1
    fi
}

function clean()
{
    if [ -n "${BUILD_DIR}" ];then
        rm -rf ${BUILD_DIR}
    fi

    mkdir -p ${BUILD_DIR} ${OUTPUT_DIR}
}

function cmake_config()
{
    local extra_option="$1"
    log "Info: cmake config ${CUSTOM_OPTION} ${extra_option} ."
    cmake ..  ${CUSTOM_OPTION} ${extra_option}
}

function build()
{
    local target="$1"
    if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ];then
        local option="--verbose"
    fi
    cmake --build . --target ${target} ${JOB_NUM} ${option}
}

function build_ut()
{
    # build transformer_op_host_ut
  if [[ "$OP_HOST_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    build transformer_op_host_ut
  fi
  if [[ "$OP_API_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    build transformer_op_api_ut
  fi
}

build_lib() {
  echo $dotted_line
  echo "Start to build libs ${BUILD_LIBS[@]}"
  clean

  if [ ! -d "${BUILD_PATH}" ]; then
    mkdir -p "${BUILD_PATH}"
  fi

  cd "${BUILD_PATH}" && cmake .. ${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_BUILT_IN=ON

  for lib in "${BUILD_LIBS[@]}"; do
    echo "Building target ${lib}"
    cmake --build . --target ${lib} ${JOB_NUM}
  done

  echo $dotted_line
  echo "Build libs ${BUILD_LIBS[@]} success"
  echo $dotted_line
}

function gen_bisheng(){
    local ccache_program=$1
    local gen_bisheng_dir=${BUILD_DIR}/gen_bisheng_dir

    if [ ! -d "${gen_bisheng_dir}" ];then
        mkdir -p ${gen_bisheng_dir}
    fi

    pushd ${gen_bisheng_dir}
    $(> bisheng)
    echo "#!/bin/bash" >> bisheng
    echo "ccache_args=""\"""${ccache_program} ${BISHENG_REAL_PATH}""\"" >> bisheng
    echo "args=""$""@" >> bisheng

    if [ "${VERBOSE}" == "true" ];then
        echo "echo ""\"""$""{ccache_args} ""$""args""\"" >> bisheng
    fi

    echo "eval ""\"""$""{ccache_args} ""$""args""\"" >> bisheng
    chmod +x bisheng

    export PATH=${gen_bisheng_dir}:$PATH
    popd
}

function build_package(){
    build package
}

function build_host(){
    build_package
}

function build_kernel(){
    build ops_kernel
}

set_ut_mode() {
  REPOSITORY_NAME="transformer"
  if [[ "$ENABLE_TEST" != "TRUE" ]]; then
    return
  fi
  UT_TEST_ALL=TRUE
  if [[ "$OP_HOST" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_HOST_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
  fi
  if [[ "$OP_API" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    OP_API_UT=TRUE
    UT_TEST_ALL=FALSE
  fi
}

find_op_dir() {
    local op_name="$1"
    local search_path="${CURRENT_DIR}/src/ops-transformer ${CURRENT_DIR}/src/ops-nn"
    find ${search_path} -type d -path "*/${op_name}" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

# 检查opapi ut目录
check_opapi_test_exists() {
    if [ "${OP_API_UT}" == "TRUE" ] ||  [ "${UT_TEST_ALL}" == "TRUE" ]; then
        OP_API_UT=TRUE
        if [[ -n "${ascend_op_name}" ]]; then
            OP_API_UT=FALSE
            IFS=';' read -ra op_names <<< "${ascend_op_name}"
            for op_name in "${op_names[@]}"; do
                op_name=$(echo "${op_name}" | xargs)
                local op_dir=$(find_op_dir "${op_name}")
                if [[ -z "${op_dir}" ]]; then
                    log "ERROR: operator directory not found for '${op_name}'"
                    exit 1
                fi

                local api_dir="${op_dir}/op_api"
                local test_api_dir="${op_dir}/tests/ut/op_api"

                if [ -d "${api_dir}" ] && [ ! -d "${test_api_dir}" ]; then
                    log "ERROR: operator ${op_name} op_api test not created"
                    exit 1
                elif [ -d "${test_api_dir}" ]; then
                    OP_API_UT=TRUE
                else
                    log "Info: ${op_name} do not have op_api impl"
                fi
            done
        fi
    fi
}

# 检查ophost ut目录
check_ophost_test_exists() {
    if [ "${OP_HOST_UT}" == "TRUE" ] || [ "${UT_TEST_ALL}" == "TRUE" ]; then
        if [[ -n "${ascend_op_name}" ]]; then
            IFS=';' read -ra op_names <<< "${ascend_op_name}"
            for op_name in "${op_names[@]}"; do
                op_name=$(echo "${op_name}" | xargs)
                local op_dir=$(find_op_dir "${op_name}")
                if [[ -z "${op_dir}" ]]; then
                    log "ERROR: operator directory not found for '${op_name}'"
                    exit 1
                fi

                local host_dir="${op_dir}/op_host"
                local test_host_dir="${op_dir}/tests/ut/op_host"

                if [ ! -d "${test_host_dir}" ]; then
                    log "ERROR: operator ${op_name} op_host test not created"
                    exit 1
                else
                    log "Info: op_host test directory found: ${test_host_dir}"
                fi
            done
        fi
    fi
}

########################################################################################################################
# 参数解析处理
########################################################################################################################

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
    -h|--help)
        help_info
        exit
        ;;
    -n|--op-name)
        ascend_op_name="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    -c|--compute-unit)
        ascend_compute_unit="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    --ccache)
        CCACHE_PROGRAM="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    -p|--package-path)
        ascend_package_path="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    -b|--build)
        BUILD="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    -f|--changed_list)
        PR_CHANGED_FILES="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    -u|--test)
        ENABLE_TEST=TRUE
        shift
        ;;
    --parent_job)
        PARENT_JOB="true"
        shift
        ;;
    --enable_host_tiling)
        HOST_TILING="true"
        shift
        ;;
    --disable-check-compatible|--disable-check-compatiable)
        CHECK_COMPATIBLE="false"
        shift
        ;;
    --op_build_tool)
        op_build_tool="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    --ascend_cmake_dir)
        ascend_cmake_dir="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    --verbose)
        VERBOSE="true"
        shift
        ;;
    --clang)
        CLANG="true"
        shift
        ;;
    --tiling-key|--tiling_key)
        TILING_KEY="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    --op_debug_config)
        OP_DEBUG_CONFIG="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    --opapi)
        BUILD_LIBS+=("opapi_transformer")
        ENABLE_CREATE_LIB=TRUE
        OP_API=TRUE
        shift
        ;;
    --ophost)
        BUILD_LIBS+=("ophost_transformer")
        ENABLE_CREATE_LIB=TRUE
        OP_HOST=TRUE
        shift
        ;;
    --ops-compile-options)
        OPS_COMPILE_OPTIONS="$2"
        shift 2
        ;;
    *)
        help_info
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
done
set_ut_mode
check_opapi_test_exists
check_ophost_test_exists

if [ -n "${ascend_compute_unit}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT=${ascend_compute_unit}"
fi

if [ -n "${ascend_op_name}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DASCEND_OP_NAME=${ascend_op_name}"
fi

if [ -n "${op_build_tool}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_BUILD_TOOL=${op_build_tool}"
fi

if [ -n "${ascend_cmake_dir}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DASCEND_CMAKE_DIR=${ascend_cmake_dir}"
fi

if [ -n "${TILING_KEY}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DTILING_KEY=${TILING_KEY}"
fi

if [ -n "${OP_DEBUG_CONFIG}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_DEBUG_CONFIG=${OP_DEBUG_CONFIG}"
fi

if [ -n "${OPS_COMPILE_OPTIONS}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOPS_COMPILE_OPTIONS=${OPS_COMPILE_OPTIONS}"
fi

if [ "${HOST_TILING}" == "true" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_HOST_TILING=true"
fi

if [[ "$OP_HOST_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_HOST_UT=TRUE"
fi
if [[ "$OP_API_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_API_UT=TRUE"
fi

if [ -n "${ENABLE_TEST}" ];then
    CUSTOM_OPTION+=" -DENABLE_TEST=TRUE"
    CUSTOM_OPTION+=" -DTESTS_UT_OPS_TEST=TRUE"
    CUSTOM_OPTION+=" -DENABLE_UT_EXEC=TRUE"
    export BASE_PATH=$(
        cd "$(dirname $0)"
        pwd
    )
    export BUILD_PATH="${BASE_PATH}/build"
fi

if [ -n "${ascend_package_path}" ];then
    ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=${ascend_package_path}
elif [ -n "${ASCEND_HOME_PATH}" ];then
    ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=${ASCEND_HOME_PATH}
elif [ -n "${ASCEND_OPP_PATH}" ];then
    ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=$(dirname ${ASCEND_OPP_PATH})
elif [ -d "${DEFAULT_TOOLKIT_INSTALL_DIR}" ];then
    ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=${DEFAULT_TOOLKIT_INSTALL_DIR}
elif [ -d "${DEFAULT_INSTALL_DIR}" ];then
    ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=${DEFAULT_INSTALL_DIR}
else
    log "Error: Please set the toolkit package installation directory through parameter -p|--package-path."
    exit 1
fi

if [ "${PARENT_JOB}" == "false" ]; then
    CPU_NUM=$(($(cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep "^processor" | wc -l)*2))
    if [ -n "${OPS_CPU_NUMBER}" ]; then
        if [[ "${OPS_CPU_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            CPU_NUM="${OPS_CPU_NUMBER}"
        fi
    fi
    JOB_NUM="-j${CPU_NUM}"
fi

CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DCUSTOM_ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH=${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH} -DCHECK_COMPATIBLE=${CHECK_COMPATIBLE}"

########################################################################################################################
# 处理流程
########################################################################################################################

set_env

clean

if [ -n "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" ]; then
    if [ "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" == "false" ] || [ "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" == "off" ]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_CCACHE=OFF"
    elif [ -f "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" ];then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_CCACHE=ON -DCUSTOM_CCACHE=${CCACHE_PROGRAM}"
        gen_bisheng ${CCACHE_PROGRAM}
    fi
else
    # 判断有无默认的ccache 如果有则使用
    ccache_system=$(which ccache || true)
    if [ -n "${ccache_system}" ];then
        CUSTOM_OPTION="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DENABLE_CCACHE=ON -DCUSTOM_CCACHE=${ccache_system}"
        gen_bisheng ${ccache_system}
    fi
fi

cd ${BUILD_DIR}
if [[ "$ENABLE_TEST" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    if [[ "$UT_TEST_ALL" == "TRUE" ]]; then
        CUSTOM_OPTION_OPHOST="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_HOST_UT=TRUE -DOP_API_UT=FALSE"
        log "Info: cmake config ${CUSTOM_OPTION_OPHOST}."
        cmake ..  ${CUSTOM_OPTION_OPHOST}
        build transformer_op_host_ut
        rm -f CMakeCache.txt
        if [[ "$OP_API_UT" == "TRUE" ]]; then
            CUSTOM_OPTION_OPAPI="${CUSTOM_OPTION} -DOP_HOST_UT=FALSE -DOP_API_UT=TRUE"
            log "Info: cmake config ${CUSTOM_OPTION_OPAPI}."
            cmake ..  ${CUSTOM_OPTION_OPAPI}
            build transformer_op_api_ut
        fi
    else
        cmake_config
        build_ut
    fi
elif [[ "$ENABLE_CREATE_LIB" == "TRUE" ]]; then
    build_lib
elif [ "${BUILD}" == "host" ];then
    cmake_config -DENABLE_OPS_KERNEL=OFF
    build_host
    # TO DO
    rm -rf ${CURRENT_DIR}/output
    mkdir -p ${CURRENT_DIR}/output
    cp ${BUILD_DIR}/*.run ${CURRENT_DIR}/output
elif [ "${BUILD}" == "kernel" ];then
    cmake_config -DENABLE_OPS_HOST=OFF
    build_kernel
elif [ -n "${BUILD}" ];then
    cmake_config
    build ${BUILD}
else
    cmake_config

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(cann_ops_adv)

option(BUILD_OPEN_PROJECT         "Build open ascend ops project."  ON)
option(ENABLE_CCACHE              "Enable ccache capability"        ON)
option(OP_API_UT                  "Enable opapi ut"                 OFF)
set(ASCEND_COMPUTE_UNIT           "ascend910_93"                    CACHE   STRING   "soc that need to be compiled")
set(ASCEND_OP_NAME                "ALL"                           CACHE   STRING   "operators that need to be compiled")
set(VENDOR_NAME                   "omni_custom_transformer"                     CACHE   STRING   "vendor name")

include(cmake/config.cmake)
include(cmake/func.cmake)
include(cmake/intf.cmake)
include(cmake/tiling_sink.cmake)
include(cmake/variables.cmake)
include(cmake/ut.cmake)
include(cmake/third_party/json.cmake)
if (ENABLE_TEST)
    include(cmake/third_party/json.cmake)
    include(cmake/third_party/gtest.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findaicpu.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findalog.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Finddlog.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findjson.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findmetadef.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findnnopbase.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findruntime.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/FindOPBASE.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findoptiling.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findplatform.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/FindPython.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findsecurec.cmake)
    include(cmake/modules/Findtilingapi.cmake)
endif()

if(PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
  message(STATUS "compile project with library")
  option(BUILD_WITH_INSTALLED_DEPENDENCY_CANN_PKG "Build ops-transformer with cann pkg" ON)
else()
  message(STATUS "compile project with src")
  option(BUILD_WITH_INSTALLED_DEPENDENCY_CANN_PKG "Build ops-transformer with cann source" OFF)
endif()

if(UNIX)
  set(SYSTEM_PREFIX ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}-linux)
endif()

set(OPS_TRANSFORMER_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

if (BUILD_OPEN_PROJECT)
    set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH
        ${CMAKE_MODULE_PATH}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/modules
    )

    set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
        ${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH}
        ${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}
    )

    set(_op_host_aclnn_link
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:intf_pub>
            exe_graph
            register
            c_sec
    )

    find_package(alog MODULE)

    if(NOT ${alog_FOUND})
        add_definitions(-DALOG_NOT_FOUND)
    endif()

    add_library(op_host_aclnn SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    target_link_libraries(op_host_aclnn PRIVATE
            ${_op_host_aclnn_link}
    )
    target_compile_options(op_host_aclnn PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=gnu++1z>
    )

    add_library(op_host_aclnnInner SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    target_link_libraries(op_host_aclnnInner PRIVATE
            ${_op_host_aclnn_link}
    )
    target_compile_options(op_host_aclnnInner PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=gnu++1z>
    )

    add_library(op_host_aclnnExc SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    target_link_libraries(op_host_aclnnExc PRIVATE
            ${_op_host_aclnn_link}
    )
    target_compile_options(op_host_aclnnExc PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=gnu++1z>
    )

    # op api
    add_library(opapi SHARED)
    # When compiling a specified operator, there is an operator without aclnn src.

    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opapi_stub.cpp
        COMMAND touch ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opapi_stub.cpp
    )

    target_sources(opapi PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opapi_stub.cpp
    )

    target_compile_options(opapi PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=gnu++1z>
    )
    target_include_directories(opapi PRIVATE
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/aclnn>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/aclnn_kernels>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/${SYSTEM_PREFIX}/pkg_inc>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/aicpu>
    )
    target_compile_options(opapi PRIVATE
            -Werror=format
    )
    target_compile_definitions(opapi PRIVATE
            -DACLNN_LOG_FMT_CHECK
    )
    target_link_libraries(opapi PRIVATE
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:intf_pub>
            -Wl,--whole-archive
            ops_aclnn
            -Wl,--no-whole-archive
            -lopapi
            nnopbase
            profapi
            ge_common_base
            ascend_dump
            ascendalog
            dl
            ${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/lib64/libops_base.so
    )
    set_target_properties(opapi PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME
            cust_opapi
    )
    install(TARGETS opapi
            LIBRARY DESTINATION packages/vendors/${VENDOR_NAME}/op_api/lib
    )

    # op proto
    add_library(opsproto SHARED)
    if (ENABLE_TEST)
        target_compile_options(opsproto PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++11>
            -fvisibility=hidden
            -g
            -O0
            --coverage
        )
    else()
        target_compile_options(opsproto PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++11>
            -fvisibility=hidden
        )
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(opsproto PRIVATE
            LOG_CPP
            PROCESS_LOG
    )
    target_link_libraries(opsproto PRIVATE
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:intf_pub>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:ops_utils_proto_headers>
            $<$<BOOL:${alog_FOUND}>:$<BUILD_INTERFACE:alog_headers>>
            -Wl,--whole-archive
            rt2_registry
            -Wl,--no-whole-archive
            -Wl,--no-as-needed
            exe_graph
            graph
            graph_base
            register
            ascendalog
            error_manager
            platform
            -Wl,--as-needed
            c_sec
            ${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/lib64/libops_base.so
    )
    set_target_properties(opsproto PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME
            cust_opsproto_rt2.0
    )
    install(TARGETS opsproto
            LIBRARY DESTINATION packages/vendors/${VENDOR_NAME}/op_proto/lib/linux/${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}
    )

    # op tiling
    add_library(optiling SHARED)

    if (ENABLE_TEST)
        target_compile_options(optiling PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++11>
            -fvisibility=hidden
            -g
            -O0
            --coverage
        )
    else()
        target_compile_options(optiling PRIVATE
            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++11>
            -fvisibility=hidden
        )
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(optiling PRIVATE
            LOG_CPP
            PROCESS_LOG
    )
    target_link_libraries(optiling PRIVATE
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:intf_pub>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:ops_utils_tiling_headers>
            $<$<BOOL:${alog_FOUND}>:$<BUILD_INTERFACE:alog_headers>>
            -Wl,--whole-archive
            rt2_registry
            -Wl,--no-whole-archive
            -Wl,--no-as-needed
            graph
            graph_base
            exe_graph
            platform
            register
            ascendalog
            error_manager
            -Wl,--as-needed
            -Wl,--whole-archive
            tiling_api
            -Wl,--no-whole-archive
            mmpa
            c_sec
            ${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/lib64/libops_base.so
    )
    set_target_properties(optiling PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME
            cust_opmaster_rt2.0
    )
    add_custom_command(TARGET optiling
            POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${TILING_CUSTOM_DIR}
            COMMAND ln -sf $<TARGET_FILE:optiling> ${TILING_CUSTOM_FILE}
    )
    install(TARGETS optiling
            LIBRARY DESTINATION packages/vendors/${VENDOR_NAME}/op_impl/ai_core/tbe/op_tiling/lib/linux/${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}
    )

    # optiling compat
    set(compat_optiling_dir  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/compat)
    set(compat_optiling_file ${compat_optiling_dir}/liboptiling.so)
    add_custom_target(optiling_compat ALL
            DEPENDS ${compat_optiling_file}
    )

    add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT ${compat_optiling_file}
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${compat_optiling_dir}
            COMMAND ln -sf lib/linux/${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}/$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:optiling> ${compat_optiling_file}
    )

    install(FILES ${compat_optiling_file}
            DESTINATION packages/vendors/${VENDOR_NAME}/op_impl/ai_core/tbe/op_tiling
    )

    add_ops_tiling_keys(
            OP_NAME "ALL"
            TILING_KEYS ${TILING_KEY}
    )

    add_opc_config(
            OP_NAME "ALL"
            CONFIG ${OP_DEBUG_CONFIG}
    )

    if(ADD_OPS_COMPILE_OPTION_V2)
        add_ops_compile_options(
                OP_NAME "ALL"
                OPTIONS ${OPS_COMPILE_OPTIONS}
        )
    endif()

    if (ENABLE_TEST)
        if (UT_TEST_ALL OR OP_HOST_UT OR OP_API_UT OR OP_KERNEL_UT OR OP_GRAPH_UT)
            add_subdirectory(src/tests/ut/framework_normal)
        endif()
    endif ()

endif ()
add_subdirectory(src/ops-transformer/common)
add_subdirectory(src/utils)

set(OP_LIST)
set(OP_DIR_LIST)
op_add_subdirectory(OP_LIST OP_DIR_LIST)

set(_HAS_OPS_NN FALSE)
foreach (_dir ${OP_DIR_LIST})
    string(FIND "${_dir}" "/src/ops-nn" _pos)
    if (_pos GREATER -1)
        set(_HAS_OPS_NN TRUE)
        break()
    endif()
endforeach()

if (_HAS_OPS_NN)
    add_subdirectory(src/ops-nn/common)
    target_include_directories(optiling PRIVATE
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/aclnn>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/aclnn_kernels>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/experiment/msprof>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/runtime>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/base>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/runtime>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/profiling>
    )
    target_include_directories(opsproto PRIVATE
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/aclnn>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/aclnn_kernels>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/include/experiment/msprof>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/runtime>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/op_common>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/base>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/runtime>
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${ASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH}/pkg_inc/profiling>
    )
endif()

foreach (OP_DIR ${OP_DIR_LIST})
    if (EXISTS "${OP_DIR}/ophost")
        add_subdirectory(${OP_DIR}/ophost)
    else()
        if (${OP_DIR} STREQUAL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ops-transformer/common/stub" OR ${OP_DIR} STREQUAL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ops-nn/common/stub")
            continue()
        endif()
        add_subdirectory(${OP_DIR})
    endif()
endforeach ()

set(OP_DEPEND_DIR_LIST)
op_add_depend_directory(
        OP_LIST ${OP_LIST}
        OP_DIR_LIST OP_DEPEND_DIR_LIST

import os
import glob
import logging
import torch
from setuptools import setup, find_packages
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import BuildExtension

import torch_npu
from torch_npu.utils.cpp_extension import NpuExtension

PYTORCH_NPU_INSTALL_PATH = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(torch_npu.__file__))
USE_NINJA = os.getenv('USE_NINJA') == '1'
BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__))
logging.basicConfig(format='%(filename)s:%(lineno)d [%(levelname)s] %(message)s', level=logging.INFO)

# Detect ACL headers
ACL_INC_DIR = os.path.join(PYTORCH_NPU_INSTALL_PATH, "include/third_party/acl/inc")


def check_acl_float8_support(acl_inc_dir):
    """Check if ACL headers define ACL_FLOAT8."""
    for root, _, files in os.walk(acl_inc_dir):
        for f in files:
            if f.endswith('.h'):
                try:
                    with open(os.path.join(root, f), 'r', errors='ignore') as fh:
                        content = fh.read()
                        if 'ACL_HIFLOAT8' in content or 'ACL_FLOAT8_E4M3FN' in content:
                            return True
                except (IOError, OSError):
                    continue
    return False

extra_compile_flags = ['-I' + ACL_INC_DIR]
if check_acl_float8_support(ACL_INC_DIR):
    extra_compile_flags.append('-DSUPPORT_ACL_FLOAT8')
    logging.info("[setup.py] ACL FLOAT8 types detected, enabling SUPPORT_ACL_FLOAT8")
else:
    logging.info("[setup.py] ACL FLOAT8 types NOT detected, disabling FLOAT8 code paths")

source_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "omni_custom_ops/csrc_base", "*.cpp"), recursive=True)
source_files += glob.glob(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "omni_custom_ops/*/*/*/csrc", "*.cpp"), recursive=True)

exts = []
ext = NpuExtension(
    name="omni_custom_ops.custom_ops_lib",
    sources=source_files,
    extra_compile_args=extra_compile_flags,
)
exts.append(ext)

setup(
    name="omni_custom_ops",
    version='1.0',
    keywords='omni_custom_ops',
    ext_modules=exts,
    package_data={
        'omni_custom_ops': ['*.py', '*.so'],
        'omni_custom_ops.converter': ['*.py', '*.so'],
    },
    packages=find_packages(),
    cmdclass={"build_ext": BuildExtension.with_options(use_ninja=USE_NINJA)},
)

from typing import (
    Any, Callable, ContextManager, Iterator, List, Literal, NamedTuple, Optional, Sequence, Tuple, TypeVar,
    Union, overload,
)
import torch
import torch_npu
import torchair
from torch import Generator, contiguous_format, inf, strided, SymInt
from torch.library import Library, impl
from torch.types import Device, Number, _bool, _complex, _device, _dtype, _float, _int, _layout, _qscheme, _size
from torchair._ge_concrete_graph import ge_apis as ge
from torchair._ge_concrete_graph.fx2ge_converter import declare_supported, register_fx_node_ge_converter
from torchair._ge_concrete_graph.supported_declaration import _TypedTensor, F32, F16, F64, I32, I16, I64, I8, U8, \
    BOOL, Support
from torchair._ge_concrete_graph.utils import dtype_promote
from torchair.ge import attr
from torchair.ge._ge_graph import Tensor, TensorSpec, DataType, TensorType, get_default_ge_graph, next_unique_name, \
    auto_convert_to_tensor, compat_as_bytes, get_invalid_desc


@register_fx_node_ge_converter(torch.ops.custom.npu_lower_triangular_inverse.default)
def conveter_npu_lower_triangular_inverse(
    x: Tensor,
    meta_outputs: TensorSpec = None
):

    return torchair.ge.custom_op(
        "LowerTriangularInverse",
        inputs={
            "x": x
        },
        outputs={
            'out'
        }
    )

import pytest

import fnmatch
import fnmatch
import pytest



def pytest_addoption(parser):
    group = parser.getgroup("resources")
    try:
        group.addoption(
            "--device",
            action="store",
            help="available device selector, e.g. npu:910B, npu:*, *:910B",
        )
        group.addoption(
            "--nodes",
            type=int,
            help="available node count (default: unlimited)",
        )
        group.addoption(
            "--npus-per-node",
            type=int,
            help="available NPUs per node (default: unlimited)",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        # 如果参数已经存在，忽略错误
        pass


def pytest_configure(config):
    config.addinivalue_line(
        "markers",
        "resources(**kwargs): hardware resource requirements",
    )
    config.addinivalue_line(
        "filterwarnings", 
        "ignore:pkg_resources is deprecated as an API"
    )


# ============================================================
# 3. device 通配匹配
# ============================================================

def device_match(req_device, cli_device):
    """
    req_device: marker 中声明的 device（需求）
    cli_device: CLI 中声明的 device（可用）

    语义：
      - CLI 未指定 => 通配，永远匹配
      - 支持双向 fnmatch
    """
    if cli_device is None:
        return True

    if req_device is None:
        return True

    if isinstance(req_device, str):
        req_device = [req_device]

    for d in req_device:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(cli_device, d) or fnmatch.fnmatch(d, cli_device):
            return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# 4. 核心：基于 resources marker 进行筛选
# ============================================================

def pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, items):
    # ---------- CLI：可用资源（None = 通配） ----------
    cli_device = config.getoption("--device")
    cli_nodes = config.getoption("--nodes")
    cli_npus = config.getoption("--npus-per-node")

    selected = []
    deselected = []

    for item in items:
        mark = item.get_closest_marker("resources")

        # 没有 resources marker → 不跑
        if not mark:
            deselected.append(item)
            continue

        req = mark.kwargs
        req_device = req.get("device", "*")
        req_nodes = req.get("nodes", 1)
        req_npus = req.get("npus_per_node", 1)

        # ---------- device 匹配 ----------
        if not device_match(req_device, cli_device):
            deselected.append(item)
            continue

        if cli_nodes is not None and cli_nodes != req_nodes:
            deselected.append(item)
            continue

        # ---------- npus_per_node：可用 != 需求 ----------
        if cli_npus is not None and cli_npus != req_npus:
            deselected.append(item)
            continue

        selected.append(item)

    if deselected:
        config.hook.pytest_deselected(items=deselected)
        items[:] = selected

input.rationale: 本仓库是 openPangu 映腾亲和算子工程的推理子仓，核心是『AscendC 算子三层结构（op_api/op_host/op_kernel）+ PyTorch 扩展（torch_ops_extension）』两大部分。学习路线因此设计为：第 1 单元先建立项目全貌、Docker/编译安装能力和对一个算子目录的直观认识；第 2 单元以最小的 ScatterBlockUpdate 算子为标本逐层拆解 OpDef 注册、aclnn 两段式接口、Tiling 七步框架与 AscendC Kernel 入门，让读者掌握每个算子共有的骨架；第 3 单元打通 PyTorch 侧：TORCH_LIBRARY 注册、ops_common 的 EXEC_NPU_CMD 调用机制、torchair converter 图模式适配，并复盘端到端调用链；第 4 单元按算子族（Attention Sink、AICPU 元数据、稀疏注意力、卷积/DeltaRule、MoE、MHC、位置编码、Matmul）精读真实大算子，展示多 Tiling 模板、AICPU 特例与 SOC 配置等变化；第 5 单元进入专家层公共机制（Tiling 框架深入、AIV/AIC 协同、fallback 与错误处理、tiling_sink）；第 6 单元以 UT/ST 测试框架与『从零新增一个算子』综合实战收尾，使读者具备二次开发能力。依赖关系上，先骨架后血肉、先单一算子后算子族、先使用后扩展，避免初学者一开始陷入大型注意力算子的细节。

learning_goals: 说出仓库的两大组成部分：AscendC 融合推理算子库与 torch_ops_extension
对照目录树找到 attention/mhc/index/posembedding/moe/ops-nn 各算子族的位置
理解 AscendC、PyPTO、Triton 三种实现方式的定位差异
lectures.practice_task: 通读两份 README 后，画出 inference/ascendc 的一级目录树并标注每个目录的职责；然后在 src/ops-transformer 下找到 5 个算子族各自的代表算子目录，记录它们的绝对路径。
lectures.title: 项目是什么：昇腾融合推理算子库全貌
lectures.topic: 介绍 openPangu-2.0-Op 仓库的整体定位与推理子仓的范围，梳理 ascendc 算子目录（ops-transformer 的 attention/mhc/index/posembedding/moe 与 ops-nn 的 matmul）以及 torch_ops_extension 的位置。

描述 run 包的生成与安装到 CANN vendors 目录的完整流程
理解 build.sh 如何把参数转成 CMake 变量并驱动不同构建目标

units.title: 测试体系与二次开发实战

data.head: c1d24e36d7fb94a98607a02b0edc88c47b64d850
data.rationale: 本仓库是 openPangu 映腾亲和算子工程的推理子仓，核心是『AscendC 算子三层结构（op_api/op_host/op_kernel）+ PyTorch 扩展（torch_ops_extension）』两大部分。学习路线因此设计为：第 1 单元先建立项目全貌、Docker/编译安装能力和对一个算子目录的直观认识；第 2 单元以最小的 ScatterBlockUpdate 算子为标本逐层拆解 OpDef 注册、aclnn 两段式接口、Tiling 七步框架与 AscendC Kernel 入门，让读者掌握每个算子共有的骨架；第 3 单元打通 PyTorch 侧：TORCH_LIBRARY 注册、ops_common 的 EXEC_NPU_CMD 调用机制、torchair converter 图模式适配，并复盘端到端调用链；第 4 单元按算子族（Attention Sink、AICPU 元数据、稀疏注意力、卷积/DeltaRule、MoE、MHC、位置编码、Matmul）精读真实大算子，展示多 Tiling 模板、AICPU 特例与 SOC 配置等变化；第 5 单元进入专家层公共机制（Tiling 框架深入、AIV/AIC 协同、fallback 与错误处理、tiling_sink）；第 6 单元以 UT/ST 测试框架与『从零新增一个算子』综合实战收尾，使读者具备二次开发能力。依赖关系上，先骨架后血肉、先单一算子后算子族、先使用后扩展，避免初学者一开始陷入大型注意力算子的细节。

learning_goals: 说出仓库的两大组成部分：AscendC 融合推理算子库与 torch_ops_extension
对照目录树找到 attention/mhc/index/posembedding/moe/ops-nn 各算子族的位置
理解 AscendC、PyPTO、Triton 三种实现方式的定位差异
lectures.practice_task: 通读两份 README 后，画出 inference/ascendc 的一级目录树并标注每个目录的职责；然后在 src/ops-transformer 下找到 5 个算子族各自的代表算子目录，记录它们的绝对路径。
lectures.title: 项目是什么：昇腾融合推理算子库全貌
lectures.topic: 介绍 openPangu-2.0-Op 仓库的整体定位与推理子仓的范围，梳理 ascendc 算子目录（ops-transformer 的 attention/mhc/index/posembedding/moe 与 ops-nn 的 matmul）以及 torch_ops_extension 的位置。

learning_goals: 说明 build.sh 的 -c/-n/--tiling_key/-u 等核心参数的含义
描述 run 包的生成与安装到 CANN vendors 目录的完整流程
理解 build.sh 如何把参数转成 CMake 变量并驱动不同构建目标
lectures.practice_task: 在有昇腾环境时执行 bash build.sh -n 'ai_infra_scatter_block_update' -c ascend910_93 并记录输出产物；无环境时，手工梳理 build.sh 中参数解析到 cmake_config/build_package 的调用路径，写成流程说明。
lectures.title: 环境准备与编译安装全流程
lectures.topic: 讲解如何准备昇腾 Docker 环境（A2/A3/A5 镜像）、source set_env.sh，以及 build.sh 的参数解析与 CMake 配置流程，最终生成并安装 CANN-omni_custom_ops 自定义算子 run 包。

learning_goals: 列出算子目录的固定子目录（docs/op_api/op_host/op_kernel/tests）及各自职责
区分 aclnnXxx 接口文件、OpDef 定义文件、Tiling 文件与 Kernel 入口文件
学会使用 docs/ 下的 aclnn 与 npu 两类接口文档
lectures.practice_task: 以 ScatterBlockUpdate 为模板，为仓库中另一个算子（如 ai_infra_mhc_sandwich_norm_post_preonly）制作一张文件清单表：每个文件属于哪一层、承担什么职责，并标注它与模板算子的差异点。
lectures.title: 解剖一个算子目录：以 ScatterBlockUpdate 为例
lectures.topic: 以体量最小的 ai_infra_scatter_block_update 为标本，逐个介绍算子目录下 docs、op_api、op_host、op_kernel、tests 各子目录的文件构成与职责分工，建立『三层结构』的直观印象。

learning_goals: 跑通 build_and_install.sh 生成并安装 omni_custom_ops wheel 包
理解 __init__.py 如何把 torch.ops.custom 命名空间挂载到 torch_npu
能够通过 torch.ops.custom.xxx 与 torch_npu.xxx 两种方式调用自定义算子
lectures.practice_task: 在有环境时编译安装 wheel 包，并仿照 example/test_npu_chunk_gated_delta_rule_recurrence.py 编写一段最小脚本调用 torch.ops.custom.npu_lower_triangular_inverse；无环境时阅读 example 脚本并写出调用一个新算子所需的完整代码清单。
lectures.title: torch_ops_extension 快速上手：在 PyTorch 中调用自定义算子
lectures.topic: 介绍 torch_ops_extension 的 wheel 打包方式（setup.py + NpuExtension）、omni_custom_ops 包结构，以及如何以 torch.ops.custom.npu_xxx / torch_npu.npu_xxx 的形式调用推理算子。

units.title: 初识项目：定位、构建与算子目录

learning_goals: 看懂 Input/Output 的 ParamType、DataType、Format 列表的对应关系
理解 OpAICoreConfig 的动态形状、动态格式等开关含义
掌握 AddConfig 指定 ascend910b/ascend910_93 等 SOC 的方式
lectures.practice_task: 参照 ScatterBlockUpdate 的 def 文件，为一个假想的 my_add 算子（输入 x、y，输出 z，支持 FP16/BF16）手写一份 op_host/my_add_def.cpp，并对照编译系统说明 OP_ADD 宏如何让算子被发现。
lectures.title: op_host 之 OpDef：算子原型注册
lectures.topic: 解读 *_def.cpp 中 OpDef 类的写法：Input/Output 的参数类型、数据类型与格式组合、UnknownShapeFormat，以及 OpAICoreConfig 的动态编译、动态格式等能力开关和 SOC 配置。

learning_goals: 说明 GetWorkspaceSize 与执行函数两段式接口的分工
理解参数三步检查（空指针/空张量/dtype 合法性）的套路
掌握 l0op::Contiguous 与 executor->CreateView 处理非连续输入的做法
lectures.practice_task: 为假想算子 my_add 编写 aclnn_my_add.cpp 的两段式骨架：实现 NotNull/Empty/Dtype 三层检查函数和 CommonProcess 中调用 l0op::MyAdd 的流程，保持与 scatter 算子一致的错误码风格。
lectures.title: op_api 层：aclnn 接口的两段式设计
lectures.topic: 精读 aclnn_ai_infra_scatter_block_update.cpp：GetWorkspaceSize 与执行函数两段式结构、CREATE_EXECUTOR、参数三步检查、Contiguous/CreateView 连续化处理，以及通过 l0op 调用 L0 算子的方式。

learning_goals: 使用 BEGIN_TILING_DATA_DEF/TILING_DATA_FIELD_DEF 定义 TilingData
说明 TilingBaseClass 七个虚函数步骤的作用与执行顺序
理解 TilingData 如何从 host 侧计算并传递到 kernel 侧
lectures.practice_task: 梳理 scatter_block_update_tiling.cpp 中 GetPlatformInfo/DoOpTiling/PostTiling 各自填充了 TilingData 的哪些字段；然后回答：如果把每个核处理的索引数改成均匀切分，需要改动哪些计算逻辑。
lectures.title: op_host 之 Tiling：TilingData 与 TilingBaseClass 七步框架
lectures.topic: 讲解 TilingData 字段定义宏（BEGIN_TILING_DATA_DEF 等）、REGISTER_TILING_DATA_CLASS，以及公共基类 TilingBaseClass 的 DoTiling 七步流程（GetShapeAttrsInfo→GetPlatformInfo→IsCapable→DoOpTiling→DoLibApiTiling→GetWorkspaceSize→PostTiling）。

learning_goals: 解释 kernel 入口宏与参数（GM_ADDR 输入输出、workspace、tiling）的来源
掌握 GET_TILING_DATA 与 TILING_KEY_IS 的作用
理解 Kernel 类 Init/Process 两段式结构与 TPipe 的角色
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 scatter_block_update.h 中 Kernel 类的模板参数与成员，画出一次 Process 调用的数据流（GM→UB→GM）；然后仿照它写出 my_add 的 kernel 入口函数（只需入口与空 Kernel 类骨架）。
lectures.title: op_kernel 层：AscendC Kernel 入门
lectures.topic: 解读 AscendC kernel 入口 extern "C" __global__ __aicore__ 的参数布局、GET_TILING_DATA 展开、TILING_KEY_IS 分支，以及 Kernel 类模板的 Init/Process 结构和 TPipe 内存管理。

learning_goals: 看懂 Infershape4To5D/InferShapeRange 的注册与实现套路
理解 *_proto.cpp 相比 *_def.cpp 的差异与适用场景
知道 InferShape 的单测文件位置以便后续验证
lectures.practice_task: 为假想算子 my_add 编写 infershape：输出形状由两个输入广播得到；并在 tests/ut/op_host 下参照 test_lower_triangular_inverse_infershape.cpp 设计至少 3 组 shape 用例。
lectures.title: InferShape 与算子 proto：输出形状如何推导
lectures.topic: 介绍 op_host 中的 Infershape 实现与 proto/图算子原型文件：以 lower_triangular_inverse 的 infershape、chunk_gated_delta_rule_recurrence 的 proto 为例，讲解输出形状推导的注册方式与实现套路。

units.title: AscendC 算子三层结构源码精读

learning_goals: 读懂 m.def 中的 Tensor/int/str/可选参数与返回多值签名语法
理解 PrivateUse1（NPU 设备）与 Meta 两个实现键的区别
掌握新增算子时『先定义后实现』的注册步骤
lectures.practice_task: 为假想算子 my_add 在 ops_def_registration.cpp 中补写 m.def 签名，并新建 csrc/my_add.cpp 同时注册 PrivateUse1 与 Meta 实现，函数体内调用 EXEC_NPU_CMD_V1(aclnnMyAdd, x, y, out)。
lectures.title: csrc 适配层：TORCH_LIBRARY 注册算子签名
lectures.topic: 解读 csrc_base/ops_def_registration.cpp 的 TORCH_LIBRARY_FRAGMENT(custom) 算子签名定义，以及每个算子 csrc 目录下 TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL 对 PrivateUse1 与 Meta 的实现注册。

learning_goals: 解释 dlopen/dlsym 按优先级查找 aclnn 符号的顺序
理解 ConvertType/Release 系列 at::Tensor→aclTensor 的桥接原理
掌握 EXEC_NPU_CMD_V1 从取函数地址到异步执行的完整流程
lectures.practice_task: 画出 EXEC_NPU_CMD_V1 宏展开后的执行时序图（GetWorkspaceSize→分配 workspace→OpCommand::RunOpApiV2→Release）；并说明为什么 converted_params 需要在异步回调里统一 Release。
lectures.title: ops_common 通用适配层：EXEC_NPU_CMD_V1 与类型转换
lectures.topic: 深入 ops_common.h：aclnn 动态库的 dlopen/dlsym 查找顺序（自定义 vendors 优先）、at::Tensor/aclTensor 等 ConvertType 桥接、EXEC_NPU_CMD_V1 宏的完整执行流程。

learning_goals: 理解 register_fx_node_ge_converter 装饰器的作用
掌握 torchair.ge.custom_op 的 inputs/outputs 映射写法
区分即时执行（csrc）与图执行（converter）两条路径
lectures.practice_task: 为假想算子 my_add 编写 converter/my_add.py：注册到 torch.ops.custom.npu_my_add.default 并映射到 GE 算子名 MyAdd；对照 lower_triangular_inverse 与 fused_infer_attention_sink 两个 converter 总结多输出/可选参数的写法差异。
lectures.title: Python converter 与 torchair 图模式适配
lectures.topic: 讲解 converter 目录下基于 torchair 的 fx2ge 转换器：register_fx_node_ge_converter 装饰器、torchair.ge.custom_op 构建 GE 图节点，使自定义算子可被图模式（torchair）捕获执行。

learning_goals: 按顺序说出从 Python 调用到 kernel 执行经过的 6 层边界
理解 run 包（aclnn/host/kernel）与 wheel 包（csrc/converter）的职责边界
掌握排查『算子调不到/找不到符号』问题的分层定位方法
lectures.practice_task: 以 npu_lower_triangular_inverse 为例编写一份完整的调用链追踪笔记，标注每层所在文件与函数名；并模拟排查场景：若 dlsym 找不到 aclnn 符号，列出按顺序检查的 5 个环节。
lectures.title: 端到端调用链复盘与 wheel 打包
lectures.topic: 把前三讲串联：从 torch.ops.custom.npu_lower_triangular_inverse 出发，经 csrc 实现、EXEC_NPU_CMD_V1、aclnn 接口、OpDef/tiling 选择、最终到 kernel 执行的全链路地图，并说明 setup.py 如何把 csrc 与 converter 打成 wheel。

units.title: PyTorch 集成与端到端调用链

learning_goals: 梳理 tiling_check_* 系列文件对上百个输入参数的校验策略
理解 tiling_v3 与 fia_tiling_nonquant_* 的分工与 TilingKey 选择
说出 kernel 侧 GQA/MLA/FlashDecode 分支的组织方式
lectures.practice_task: 统计 fused_infer_attention_sink 算子 op_host 与 op_kernel 的文件数量并归类；然后回答：新增一种 head_dim 组合时，需要同步检查哪些 tiling_check 文件与 kernel 头文件。
lectures.title: FusedInferAttentionSink：旗舰注意力融合算子
lectures.topic: 精读仓库中最复杂的推理算子 ai_infra_fused_infer_attention_sink：几十个可选输入与量化/sink 参数、tiling_check 系列校验文件、GQA/MLA 多场景 tiling 拆分（fia_tiling_nonquant_mla_sink 等）。

learning_goals: 对比 AICPU 算子与 AICore 算子在目录结构与实现语言上的差异
理解 op_graph/proto 与 op_kernel_aicpu 中 json 描述的作用
掌握主算子与元数据算子配合使用的模式
lectures.practice_task: 编写一张对比表：AICore 算子（scatter）与 AICPU 算子（sink metadata）在目录、入口、构建产物上的差异；并说明 metadata 的输出会被主算子的哪个输入消费（结合 docs 文档）。
lectures.title: AICPU 算子特例：AttentionSink Metadata
lectures.topic: 分析不走 AICore 而走 AICPU 的元数据算子：op_kernel_aicpu 目录、op_graph 原型、l0_ 前缀的 L0 接口，以及它如何为主算子准备 mask/sink 元数据。

learning_goals: 说明 sparse_indices/实际序列长度等输入如何缩小注意力计算范围
对比 GQA 版与 Pioneer 版在输入（query_rope、sink、metadata）上的扩展
理解 lightning indexer/esa_topk 与主注意力算子的配合关系
lectures.practice_task: 绘制稀疏注意力家族的『算子协作图』：标出 sparse_flash_attention_gqa、metadata、esa_select_topk、quant_lightning_indexer、kv_quant 版本各自消费/生产哪些张量；并用 docs 中的接口签名佐证。
lectures.title: 稀疏注意力家族：GQA、Pioneer 与 KV 量化
lectures.topic: 横向对比 ai_infra_sparse_flash_attention_gqa、_pioneer、kv_quant_sparse_flash_attention 及配套的 sparse_flash_attn_metadata、esa_select_topk、quant_lightning_indexer，理解稀疏注意力流水线中各算子的分工。

learning_goals: 解释 conv_states 缓存与 run_mode/block_size 等参数如何支撑增量推理
理解 chunk 化递推 kernel 的 tilingdata 与 kernel 头文件分工
掌握通过 example 脚本验证线性注意力类算子的方法
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 example/test_npu_chunk_gated_delta_rule_recurrence.py，整理各输入张量的形状与含义；然后仿照它写一段调用 ai_infra_fused_causal_conv1d 的伪代码（含 conv_states 初始化与两次增量调用）。
lectures.title: 因果卷积与 Delta Rule 递推：线性注意力配套算子
lectures.topic: 讲解 ai_infra_fused_causal_conv1d（状态缓存、fn/update 两种模式）与 ai_infra_chunk_gated_delta_rule_recurrence（分块门控递推），以及配套的下三角求逆 ai_infra_lower_triangular_inverse。

learning_goals: 解释 *_binary.json 与 *_simplified_key.ini 两个配置文件的作用
梳理 moe_v3_sort/gather/mrgsort 等 kernel 模板对应的 TilingKey 分支
理解 drop_pad/量化等模式组合如何映射到 kernel 变体
lectures.practice_task: 以 moe 算子为例列出『tiling 模板 → TilingKey → kernel 头文件』对照表；再尝试为 droppad+动态量化组合指出应实例化哪个 kernel 模板，并说明依据。
lectures.title: MoE InitRouting V3：多 Tiling 模板与 SOC 配置
lectures.topic: 解读 ai_infra_moe_init_routing_v3：op_host/config 下按 SOC 的 binary.json 与 simplified_key.ini 配置、tiling 模板注册，以及 kernel 侧 30 余个 moe_v3_* 头文件按量化/droppad/排序策略组合的模块化设计。

learning_goals: 解释 pre_split_post_res 与 sandwich_norm_post_preonly 在 MHC 结构中的位置
对比 single_tile/multi_tile 与 singlecore/dualcore 的分支策略
理解 v2 接口新增 return_h_in_f32 输出的动机
lectures.practice_task: 对比两个 MHC 算子的 kernel 目录：列出各自的多分支实现文件与选择条件；然后用 npu 文档中的公式解释 pre 与 post 算子的输入输出对应关系。
lectures.title: MHC 算子：流形约束超连接的前后处理
lectures.topic: 解读面向新架构的 MHC（Manifold Constrained Hyper Connection）两个推理算子：pre_split_post_res 的单/多 tile 切分，sandwich_norm_post_preonly 的单核/双核与多 tile（_mt）实现。

learning_goals: 解释 cache_mode/rotary_mode/quant_mode 组合出的多 kernel 变体（b16_pa、nz、mtp 等）
理解 arch35 专用 regbase tiling 与通用 tiling 的差异
说明 rotary_mul 的 rotate half 实现要点
lectures.practice_task: 列出 kv_rms_norm_rope_cache 的 kernel 变体命名规律表（b16/pa/nz/mtp/quant/arch35），并为『page attention + NZ 格式 + 静态量化』场景选出正确的 kernel 头文件与 tiling 文件。
lectures.title: PosEmbedding：KV RMSNorm+RoPE Cache 与旋转位置编码
lectures.topic: 解读 ai_infra_kv_rms_norm_rope_cache（RMSNorm+RoPE 后写入 KV Cache，支持 PageAttention/NZ/MTP/量化等多种模式与 arch35 特化）与 ai_infra_rotary_position_embedding（rotate half 实现）。

learning_goals: 梳理 matmul 公共库（matmul.cpp/util、batch、fused、v2tov3）的复用层次
理解 simplified_key 与 runtime_kb.json 在编译期/运行期的作用
说明 L2 cache 优化与 ND2NZ 格式转换 kernel 的设计动机
lectures.practice_task: 画出 ai_infra_matmul 从 aclnn 接口到 arch32 kernel 的模块依赖图，标注 simplifiedkey/l2_cache/tuning 各自影响哪个环节；并对比 ops-nn 与 ops-transformer 两套 common 目录中 tiling_base 的差异。
lectures.title: ops-nn 的 AiInfraMatmul：复用公共算子基建
lectures.topic: 解读 ops-nn 下的 ai_infra_matmul：与 transformer 算子不同的 common 基建（level0/level2 工具、tiling 缓存与 hash）、simplified_key、runtime_kb.json 平台调优配置与 ND2NZ kernel 变体。

learning_goals: 解释 DoTiling 返回值三态（成功/失败/本类不支持）驱动的模板轮询机制
掌握 tiling_key.h 中 key 的编码约定与 templates_registry 的注册套路
理解 ops-nn 侧 tiling_cache/hash 对 matmul 类算子的加速作用
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 tiling_templates_registry.h 与两个算子的 tiling.cpp，说明『一个算子注册多个 tiling 类』时的选择顺序；然后为 kv_rms_norm_rope_cache 写出它的 tiling 模板链（base → ds → arch35 regbase）。
lectures.title: 公共 Tiling 框架深入：模板注册与 key 体系
lectures.topic: 系统讲解 ops-transformer/common 的 tiling 基建：TilingBaseClass 返回值三态语义（支持多 tiling 类轮询）、tiling_key/tiling_type/tiling_util/tiling_templates_registry，以及 ops-nn 侧的 tiling_cache 与 hash 缓存机制。

learning_goals: 区分 Vector 核心（AIV）与 Cube 核心（AIC）在注意力算子中的分工
理解 cross-core set/wait 原语在 block 级流水中的作用
掌握 flashdecode 向量核并行分解注意力的思路
